task_text: Return the served ball: hit it with the paddle so that it lands on the opponent's half of the table (MyoChallenge 2025 TableTennis P1's own success test on the ball's contact history: after the serve's bounce on your half, the paddle touches it once, then it touches the opponent's half, with no second paddle touch and no further bounce on your half). Failure (the episode ends): any other outcome of the rally, the ball falling below 0.3 m, or 3 s of simulated time.
